fields.name: buffer_chunk_size
fields.description: By default the buffer to store the incoming Forward messages, don't allocate the maximum memory allowed, instead it allocate memory when it's required. The rounds of allocations are set by buffer_chunk_size. The value must be according to the Unit Size specification.

fields.name: buffer_max_size
fields.description: Specify the maximum buffer memory size used to receive a Forward message. The value must be according to the Unit Size specification.

fields.name: empty_shared_key
fields.description: Enable secure forward protocol with a zero-length shared key. Use this to enable user authentication without requiring a shared key, or to connect to Fluentd with a zero-length shared key.

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP port to listen for incoming connections.

fields.name: security.users
fields.description: Specify the username and password pairs for secure forward authentication. Requires shared_key or empty_shared_key to be set.

fields.name: shared_key
fields.description: Shared key for secure forward authentication.

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Override the tag of the forwarded events with the defined value.

fields.name: tag_prefix
fields.description: Prefix incoming tag with the defined value.

fields.name: threaded
fields.description: Indicates whether to run this input in its own thread.

fields.name: unix_path
fields.description: Specify the path to Unix socket to receive a Forward message. If set, listen and port are ignored.

fields.name: unix_perm
fields.description: Set the permission of the Unix socket file. If unix_path isn't set, this parameter is ignored.
